name: Ephai
overview: Ephai is a male figure identified in Scripture as the Netophathite, a designation indicating he was from Netophah. Beyond this unique attribute, little else is recorded about his tribe or background, and no additional notes are provided. His brief mention situates him within the context of the post-exilic community.
namesAndTitles: The name Ephai means 'my bird' in the original language. This proper name is recorded without indication that it was given by God, simply serving as his personal identifier in Scripture.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Ephai beyond his designation as the Netophathite. There are no listed relatives or connections detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Ephai's mention as a Netophathite places him among the returning exiles or inhabitants associated with Netophah, a community known from the post-exilic period. His inclusion in Jeremiah 40:8 highlights his role as part of the remnant community during a critical time of restoration and reorganization following the Babylonian exile. Though brief, his presence contributes to the historical and spiritual narrative of God's faithfulness to His people.
